commit cac87a8fe0e73207c8dcbb5f9fdcc11a560cfa46
Author:     Vineet Deo <vineet@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jan 27 14:55:14 2026 -0700
Commit:     Vineet Deo <vineet@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 2005497 - Intermittent comm/mail/test/browser/account/browser_accountHubOAuth.js: Use test timeout instead of waitForCondition. r=mkmelin
    
    
    This test failure started popping up as soon as we added a timeout between between fetching calendars and address books. Using waitForMutationCondition instead of waitForCondition should fix this.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D280593

diff --git a/mail/test/browser/account/browser_accountHubOAuth.js b/mail/test/browser/account/browser_accountHubOAuth.js
index dba0b90a427..9d0781f771f 100644
--- a/mail/test/browser/account/browser_accountHubOAuth.js
+++ b/mail/test/browser/account/browser_accountHubOAuth.js
@@ -75,9 +75,13 @@ add_task(async function test_account_oauth_imap_account() {
     "Should be loading"
   );
 
-  await TestUtils.waitForCondition(
-    () => BrowserTestUtils.isHidden(configFoundTemplate),
-    "The config found subview should be hidden."
+  await BrowserTestUtils.waitForMutationCondition(
+    configFoundTemplate,
+    {
+      attributes: true,
+      attributeFilter: ["hidden"],
+    },
+    () => BrowserTestUtils.isHidden(configFoundTemplate)
   );
 
   const imapAccount = MailServices.accounts.accounts.find(
